question: Who are our top 10 customers by spend?
sql:
SELECT
  oi.user_id,
  u.state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM s_order_items AS oi
JOIN s_orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN s_users  AS u ON u.id = oi.user_id
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY oi.user_id, u.state
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
report: Ranked buyers with their order counts, so a single large purchase can be told apart from a genuinely loyal customer. Identifiers come through pseudonymised, which is enough to act on a segment without naming anyone.
